sloka: इयं शुद्धसमाचारा अपापा पतिदेवता ।लोकापवादभीतस्य प्रत्ययं तव दास्यति ।। ७.९६.२३ ॥
transliteration: iyaṁ śuddhasamācārā apāpā patidevatā ।lokāpavādabhītasya pratyayaṁ tava dāsyati ।। 7.96.23 ॥

translations.english: This Sita, who is of pure conduct, sinless, and devoted to her husband as a deity, will provide conviction to you, who feared public scandal.
